verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation or examples showing LangGraph's model-provider abstraction (e.g., init_chat_model or swappable chat-model classes) that would let a developer change LLM providers without rewriting agent logic. The only tangential mention (langgraph-comm-6) references 'bring your own keys' apps but notes the commenter migrated away to LiteLLM for that need, which does not substantiate the capability. Missing for 10: first-party docs on provider-agnostic model interfaces, examples of switching providers/models in a graph, and any independent confirmation this works without code changes.
